description: Takes one entry off a spec's feedback for good. The person who sent an entry can take their own back, and Spekkr's operators can remove any entry. A spec's publisher cannot remove feedback on their spec: answer_feedback answers it. This tool needs sign-in. Ask the person before you call it.

entry.description: The entry's number, as get_feedback gives it.

name: remove_feedback
title: Take feedback back
